description: Full-pipeline snapshot tests that lock the engine's behavior on canonical personas used in the product demo. A failure here does NOT necessarily mean the engine is wrong — it means something changed and a human has to look. Tax code is compliance-critical; silent drift is not acceptable.

cases.name: Michael & Jennifer Thompson — MFJ, 1 kid, Delta W-2, Mr. Cooper mortgage
cases.citation: Demo persona in the TaxGraph v4.1 pitch (P in engine-source.jsx); purchase-loan scenario (April 2024), state inc withholding fed into SALT
cases.rationale: Snapshot captured directly from engine run on 2026-04-08. Thompson's refund of $8,667 is the headline number on screen S5; if it moves, the product's demo breaks and we need to know why.
